integrity: The upper bound is certified by an exact finite support-facet exhaustion over the full continuum, using arithmetic in Q(sqrt(5)); the sharp branch pairs are verified algebraically. The ordinary midpoint James value is treated as an endpoint, not as the novelty claim. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the affine-regular decagonal norm. It gives the full weighted profile and explicit branch maximizers but does not classify all maximizing pairs or extend the formula to arbitrary regular polygons.
title: Exact weighted James profile of the affine-regular decagonal Banach plane
